Click on a district to see full results. You can also download our spreadsheet of all 2022 district results. This spreadsheet has all the lower house district results for the final recheck of first preference votes. This includes own-district votes by election day and early voting centre locations.

Please be aware that this data has been prepared for use by analysts and statistical software. We recommend using the election results pages below for everyday use.
